title: Firewine Barrel
summary: Fire damage detonates the barrel for 4d6 Fire in about a 20 ft radius.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw the barrel up to 60 ft. It breaks to create an Alcohol surface. Dropping it into fire can detonate it.
fields.Explosion: Fire damage detonates the barrel in about a 20 ft radius. DC 14 Dexterity halves 4d6 Fire damage. Targets in the blast are pushed about 10 ft without a save.
fields.Surfaces: Breaking the barrel spills flammable Alcohol. Igniting the spill creates Fire that immediately applies Burning.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
